hero.title: STUDY MBBS IN TAJIKISTAN
hero.subtitle: Explore MBBS Opportunities in Tajikistan 2026–2027. Government universities in Dushanbe with modern teaching hospitals and low tuition.

overview: Tajikistan offers affordable medical education in government institutions. The capital Dushanbe provides safe, welcoming, and scenic surroundings with direct flight connectivity from India.

universities.name: Avicenna Tajik State Medical University
universities.desc: Founded in 1939, named after Abu Ali Ibn Sino, the flagship state medical university.

universities.name: Khatlon State Medical University
universities.desc: Government medical university offering focused clinical training and dedicated Indian hostel.

universities.name: Tajik National University
universities.desc: Prestigious national university with an expanding medical faculty and modern laboratory equipment.

faq.question: Is MBBS from Tajikistan valid in India?
faq.answer: Yes, degrees from NMC and WHO recognized universities in Tajikistan are valid for the NExT/FMGE licensing examination in India.

faq.question: What is the medium of instruction in Tajikistan?
faq.answer: All courses for international students are conducted in 100% English medium.
